businesses.business: video delivery and broadband access equipment and software

offering_description.value: Sells video delivery software and SaaS (video streaming, processing, origination) to broadcasters, pay-TV operators and streaming providers, and cable broadband access hardware and software (virtualized cable modem termination systems) to cable operators. Products are developed in-house and delivered as software, appliances and cloud services.

primary_products.value: video streaming and processing software; cable broadband access platforms (virtualized CMTS); video compression encoders; media servers and playout systems

primary_services.value: video streaming software-as-a-service; technical support and maintenance; professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: cable operators, pay-TV providers, broadcasters, streaming and media companies, telecom operators

end_markets.value: media and entertainment; broadcast television; cable and telecommunications; streaming video; sports

revenue_model.value: product sales: broadband access hardware, software licenses and appliances; subscription: cloud video streaming SaaS and recurring software subscriptions; service fees: support, maintenance and professional services contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds broadband access hardware and appliances, sold to cable operators; software / platform: video processing and delivery software and SaaS for broadcasters and service providers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: video delivery software/SaaS and cable broadband access, both serving cable and media operators

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large operators and broadcasters; partners / resellers: system integrators and resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus export controls and product safety/telecom equipment standards
